City of Encinitas
Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission Meeting
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
San Diego County Sheriff's Office Enforcement Report
Sergeant Kristy Trampus, San Diego County Sheriff's Department
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 04A Enforcement Report
4B.
San Dieguito Union High School District Presentation on Bicycle and E-Bike Safety Education
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 04B SDUHSD Presentation
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission. All Oral Communications speaker requests must be received by the Clerk by the start of oral communications. Up to 30 minutes are available for comments on items not on the agenda. Remarks must be addressed to the Commission as a whole. State law prohibits Commission action on non?agenda items. As appropriate, comments may be referred to the appropriate staff for follow?up or placement on a future agenda. Please be aware that the Chair has the authority to reduce equally each speaker’s time to accommodate a larger number of speakers.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES
7A.
August 10, 2026, Regular Meeting Minutes
Approve the August 10, 2026, Regular Meeting Minutes
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 07A Minutes DRAFT August 2026
8.
ACTION ITEMS To speak on action items, please submit a speaker request to the Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission. Please be aware that the Chair has the authority to reduce equally each speaker’s time to accommodate a larger number of speakers.
8A.
Designation of Stop Control at Various Intersections in the City
Review and recommend the proposed All-Way Stop Control (AWSC) implementation at the intersections of Lone Jack Road/Fortuna Ranch Road and A Street/2nd Street, and Minor Road Stop Control (MRSC) at the intersection of A Street/5th Street.
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 08A AWSC Various Intersections
8B.
Signing and Striping Plans for FY 2026-27 Annual Pavement Rehabilitation
Project (CS27A)
Support the signing and striping plans for the FY 2026-27 Annual Pavement Rehabilitation Project (CS27A).
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 08B Striping Plans for 2026-27 Annual Pavement Rehab
8C.
Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission Fiscal Year 2026-27 Work Plan
Discuss and take possible action on work plan items for FY 2026-27.
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 08C MTSC Work Plan
9.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
9A.
Reconsideration of MTSC Support for HSIP Cycle Track Improvements Utilizing Class IV Bikeways, Commissioner Ron Medak
Recommend that MTSC reverse its previous approval of these two designs.
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 09A Medak HSIP 12
9B.
Citywide Street Safety Review, Commissioner Leigh Ratcliffe
Identify and recommend actionable strategies related to conditions present at El Camino del Norte that the city can implement citywide to make streets safer for all road users.
2026-09-14 MTSC Item 09B Ratcliffe Street Safety
10.
COMMISSIONER CORNER AND POTENTIAL FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Roundtable and items to be added to a future agenda with consensus of two or more Commission members.

ADJOURNMENT

Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission Fiscal Year 2026-27 Work Plan
